Duplicate bibliography entries
'Nine' groups vs eight rows

'Practical yardstick' not shown to change a conclusion; one-model comparison
Typos, duplicate references, footnote inconsistency

Experimental report with limited conceptual contribution
Findings described with vague qualitative terms
